From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

exemple (plural exemples)

  1. Obsolete form of example.

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin exemplum.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [əɡˈzem.plə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [eɡˈzɛm.ple]
  • Audio (Catalonia):(file)

Noun

[edit]

exemple m (plural exemples)

  1. example

Derived terms

[edit]
  • per exemple

Further reading

[edit]
  • “exemple”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “exemple”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “exemple” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “exemple” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin exemplum. Displaced native Old French essample.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɛɡ.zɑ̃pl/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Switzerland (Valais)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Homophone: exemples

Noun

[edit]

exemple m (plural exemples)

  1. example

Derived terms

[edit]
  • ça par exemple
  • donner l'exemple
  • montrer l'exemple
  • par exemple
  • prendre exemple

Descendants

[edit]
  • Haitian Creole: egzanp
  • Mauritian Creole: egzanp
  • → Romanian: exemplu

Further reading

[edit]
  • “exemple”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012

Occitan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin exemplum.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (Béarn):(file)

Noun

[edit]

exemple m (plural exemples)

  1. example

Related terms

[edit]
  • exemplar
  • exemplificar

Romanian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [eɡˈzem.ple]

Noun

[edit]

exemple n pl

  1. plural of exemplu
